headlines.title: At least 30 people killed after Russia bombs two buses in Ukraine
headlines.description: At least 30 people were killed when a Russian bomb struck two buses in the Ukrainian city of Kramatorsk, local officials said, as Moscow’s intensifies attacks.

headlines.title: Preparations ramp up as Hurricane Isaias approaches the Gulf Coast
headlines.description: Hurricane Isaias surges toward the Gulf Coast and is expected to intensify into a Category 2 storm. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports from Pensacola Beach, Florida, where preparations are underway after the state declares a state of emergency for 25 counties.

headlines.title: NASA SpaceX Crew-12 return to Earth after undocking from the ISS
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as the NASA SpaceX Crew-12 return to Earth after undocking from the International Space Station. The crew will splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of California.

headlines.title: Accused Cornell Frat Member Seeks to Have AG James Removed
headlines.description: Gillio Lopes, one of the seven fraternity members accused of sexually assaulting a student back in 2024, is taking legal action, calling the governor’s appointment of New York Attorney General Letitia James “improper,” saying she’s already formed an opinion about the case in comments in social media. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Oil prices hit $105 and stocks trade lower as Trump considers renewed strikes on Iran
headlines.description: The price of oil on jumped sharply as President Donald Trump weighed whether to resume large-scale U.S. military operations in Iran during the coming weeks.

headlines.title: Hundreds of thousands still at risk of climate-linked floods in Nepal
headlines.description: Long before a wave of water rushed down the Bhote Koshi river and its tributaries, researchers were working to calculate just how many people are living downstream and exposed to potentially catastrophic flood risk in the areas that drain from Nepal’s high mountain basins.

headlines.title: Christa Pike is ‘Angry and Confused’ After Failed Execution
headlines.description: Death row inmate Christa Pike’s attorneys are shedding new light on her ongoing health struggles following the failed execution. “She has pneumonia. She is not able to swallow yet, so she has not eaten,” her attorney said, adding about her mental state, “She is angry and confused about everything right now.” Meanwhile, her legal team is renewing calls for the governor to commute her death sentence. NBC’s Aaron Gilchrist reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: An AI-generated Rumpelstiltskin meme is freaking out much of the internet
headlines.description: The creepy Rumpelstiltskin-like imp has become a viral meme template. The AI clip looked so real that many assumed it was from an old film.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Gas prices face new threat as Hurricane Isaias forces Gulf oil shutdowns
headlines.description: Hurricane Isaias threatens to disrupt U.S. oil and gasoline production at a moment when retail gas and diesel prices are squeezing American consumers.
